commands.review_summary:
The PR adds a build-readiness helper, deferred polling restart path, exit-handler guard, declaration update, and watch-node tests for gateway hot-reload restarts when `dist/entry.js` or the build stamp is not ready.

PR surface: Tests +147, Other +109. Total +256 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Yes from source: current main stops the watched child before `run-node` rebuilds, and the PR branch can wait for a matching build stamp without starting the process that creates it; no destructive live systemd reproduction was run in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] Manual review is needed because the blocker is lifecycle design plus contributor real-setup proof, not a small mechanical cleanup that automation can safely finish.

target.title: fix(gateway): defer hot-reload restart when dist/entry.js is missing
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Pushing commits into a live production git checkout triggers the gateway's hot-reload while  is mid-rebuild. The watcher ( in ) immediately sends SIGTERM to the current healthy child process without checking whether the replacement build is valid for the new checkout state. The new child cannot start -> crash-loop until systemd's start-limit is exhausted (37-min outage, P1, issue #99603).

## Changes

Three layers of guard in  (+3 files, +260 / -4 lines):

### Layer 1 — isBuildReadyForRestart(cwd, fs, resolveHead)

Verifies dist/entry.js exists AND the build stamp git HEAD matches the current checkout HEAD. If HEAD changed (git push), run-node would rebuild and wipe dist/, so the restart is deferred.

### Layer 2 — pollBuildReady() (800ms polling)

When build is not ready, polls every 800ms instead of dropping the restart request. When the build completes (entry.js + matching stamp appear), auto-triggers the restart without requiring another file change.

### Layer 3 — Exit handler guard

After SIGTERM/143 child exit, verifies build readiness before restarting. Prevents self-reinforcing crash-loop.

## Evidence

### Real behavior proof (18/18 checks)

Command: 



### Unit tests (24/24 passed)



9 new tests covering:
- isBuildReadyForRestart pure function (entry.js, stamp, HEAD match/mismatch)
- requestRestart defers + polls when build not ready
- requestRestart auto-restarts when poll detects build completion
- Exit handler defers on missing build
- Exit handler restarts when build is ready (regression)

### Broader regression (91/91 passed)



### Lint + TypeScript



### Scope

This is a **partial mitigation** — it prevents the crash-loop but keeps the restart ordering (stop-then-start). A full transactional restart (build-then-swap) would be a stronger fix. Issue #99603 should remain open for the stronger fix.

Competing PR #99610 targets the same root cause with a polling-based approach. Maintainers should choose one canonical lifecycle repair.

## Review

- AI-assisted: Yes
